answer: Every claim climbs the timber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the trellis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. The crystal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
